name: clearpath
description: CLEARPATH - Digital Student Clearance and Exam Eligibility Verification System

scripts.dev:backend: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev -w apps/backend
scripts.dev:setup: npm run docker:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:start:
npm run dev:setup && echo "
═══════════════════════════════════════
  ClearPath Development Servers
═══════════════════════════════════════
  Frontend: http://localhost:3000
  Backend:  http://localhost:4000
  API Docs: http://localhost:4000/api/docs
  Swagger:  http://localhost:4000/api/docs
═══════════════════════════════════════
" && npm run dev
scripts.dev:start:turbo: npm run dev:setup && npm run dev:turbopack
scripts.dev:reset: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:up && npm run db:reset
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/backend && npm run test -w apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/backend && npm run lint -w apps/frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint -w apps/backend -- --fix && npm run lint -w apps/frontend -- --fix
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/.next apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
